analysis.canvasSummary: A 1672x941 Chinese corporate annual strategy and performance infographic. The left half contains a branded skyline hero, 2025 strategy roadmap, strategic goals, capability pillars, and corporate values. The right half contains 2024 KPI cards, a business-structure donut chart, a 2022–2025 performance chart, and a dark-blue quotation footer.
analysis.backgroundDescription: Full-canvas white and pale-blue corporate infographic backdrop with the left-side smart-city skyline, layered mountains, luminous blue wave/grid artwork, right-side soft panel shading, section-header gradients, and the dark-blue curved quotation footer. Independent text, logos, icons, charts, cards, and data marks are excluded from the repaired background.
